sentence: The report was written by the manager
hint: Passive: subject + was/were + past participle + by agent
explanation: Pasiva en pasado: 'was written'. El agente va después de 'by'.

sentence: English is spoken in many countries around the world
explanation: Pasiva en presente: 'is spoken' (no la forma activa 'speaks'). Aquí no se necesita agente.

sentence: The new hospital was built last year
explanation: Pasiva en pasado: 'was built'. 'Build' es irregular: built (no 'builded').

sentence: The students are taught by experienced teachers
explanation: 'Students' es plural: 'are taught' (no 'is taught').

sentence: The window was broken during the storm
explanation: Pasiva en pasado sin agente: 'was broken during the storm'.

sentence: The cake was made by my grandmother
explanation: Pasiva en pasado: 'was made'. 'Make' es irregular: made (no 'maked').

sentence: These cars are manufactured in Germany
explanation: 'Cars' es plural: 'are manufactured' (no 'is manufactured').

sentence: The meeting was canceled due to bad weather
explanation: Pasiva en pasado: 'was canceled'. 'Due to' introduce la razón.

sentence: The letter was sent to the wrong address
explanation: 'Send' es irregular: sent (no 'sended').

sentence: Coffee is grown in tropical countries
explanation: Pasiva en presente para hechos generales: 'is grown'.

sentence: The homework must be completed before Friday
hint: Modal passive: modal + be + past participle
explanation: Pasiva con modal: 'must be completed'. Modal + be + participio pasado.

sentence: The children were taken to the hospital by ambulance
explanation: 'Children' es plural: 'were taken' (no 'was taken').

sentence: This song was recorded in a famous studio
explanation: Pasiva en pasado: 'was recorded'. El lugar va al final.

sentence: The rules should be followed by all employees
explanation: Pasiva con modal: 'should be followed'. El agente va después de 'by'.

sentence: The bridge was designed by a famous architect
explanation: Pasiva en pasado con agente: 'was designed by'.

sentence: Tickets can only be purchased online before the event
explanation: Pasiva con modal: 'can be purchased'. 'Only' añade una restricción. 'Before the event' especifica el momento.

sentence: The exam results were announced this morning
explanation: 'Results' es plural: 'were announced' (no 'was announced').

sentence: The food is prepared fresh every day
explanation: Pasiva en presente para rutinas: 'is prepared'.

sentence: The project will be finished by the end of the month
hint: Future passive: will + be + past participle
explanation: Pasiva en futuro: 'will be finished'. 'By' indica el plazo.

sentence: The museum was visited by thousands of tourists last summer
explanation: Pasiva en pasado con agente y expresión de tiempo al final.
